faq.title: Everything to know before you rent
faq.paymentQuestion: Do I have to pay online?
faq.paymentAnswer: No. DriveTN never collects any payment: you pay the agency directly when you pick up the car.
faq.documentsAnswer: Your ID card or passport and a valid driving licence. Each agency states its own conditions (minimum age, years of driving).
faq.depositAnswer: The agency asks for a deposit at pick-up, using the methods it accepts, and returns it when you bring the car back.
faq.contactQuestion: How do I reach the agency?
faq.contactAnswer: As soon as your booking is sent, you can contact the agency by phone or WhatsApp.
